items.title: Agent Island: A Saturation- and Contamination-Resistant Benchmark from Multiagent Games
items.title_zh: Agent Island：源自多智能体博弈、抗饱和与抗污染的基准
items.summary: Agent Island is a multiplayer simulation where language-model agents compete in a game of cooperation, conflict and persuasion, designed to resist saturation and contamination and ranked with a Bayesian Plackett-Luce model that quantifies uncertainty in player skill. In 999 games involving 49 models, openai/gpt-5.5 had a posterior mean skill of 5.64 versus 3.10 for the second-ranked model, and models were 8.3 percentage points more likely to support a same-provider finalist.

items.title: EnterpriseRAG-Bench: A RAG Benchmark for Company Internal Knowledge
items.title_zh: EnterpriseRAG-Bench：面向公司内部知识的 RAG 基准
items.summary: EnterpriseRAG-Bench provides a synthetic enterprise corpus of about 500,000 documents across nine source types and 500 questions in ten categories, with cross-document coherence and realistic noise such as near-duplicates and conflicting information. It includes a generation framework, evaluation harness and leaderboard so teams can create variants for their own industry and source mix.

items.title: Rethinking Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval: Evaluating and Advancing Retrievers in Agentic Search Systems
items.title_zh: 重新思考推理密集型检索：评估并推进智能体搜索系统中的检索器
items.summary: The authors introduce BRIGHT-Pro, an expert-annotated benchmark that expands each query with multi-aspect gold evidence and evaluates retrievers under static and agentic search protocols. They also build RTriever-Synth, an aspect-decomposed synthetic corpus used to LoRA fine-tune RTriever-4B from Qwen3-Embedding-4B, which substantially improves over its base model.

items.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
items.title_zh: GLM-5V-Turbo：迈向多模态智能体的原生基础模型
items.summary: A technical report introduces GLM-5V-Turbo, which treats multimodal perception as a core part of reasoning, planning, tool use and execution for agents over images, video, webpages, documents and GUIs. The report drew 163 points and 32 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent Architecture for Traceable, Risk-Aware Human-AI Decision Support in Manufacturing
items.title_zh: 基于物理约束的多智能体架构：面向制造业可溯源、风险感知的人机决策支持
items.summary: MAKA separates intent routing, tools-only quantitative analysis, knowledge graph retrieval and critic-based verification that enforces physical plausibility, safety bounds and provenance before human approval. On a Ti-6Al-4V rotor blade machining testbed, it improved successful tool execution by up to 87.5 percentage points over an unstructured single-model pattern with identical tool access.

items.title: Safety and accuracy diverge across deployment conditions in clinical large language models
items.title_zh: 临床大模型的安全性在不同部署条件下与准确性背离
items.summary: The study introduces SaFE-Scale and RadSaFE-200, a 200-question radiology benchmark with clinician-defined clean evidence, conflict evidence and option-level safety labels, and evaluates 34 local LLMs across six deployment conditions. Clean clinician-written evidence raised mean accuracy from 73.5% to 94.1% and cut high-risk errors from 12.0% to 2.6%, while standard and agentic RAG did not reproduce that safety profile.

items.title: Domain-Adaptive Dense Retrieval for Brazilian Legal Search
items.title_zh: 面向巴西法律检索的领域自适应稠密检索
items.summary: The paper compares three Qwen3-Embedding-4B training setups for Brazilian legal retrieval: no fine-tuning, legal-only data and a mix of legal data with SQuAD-pt. The mixed setup improved average NDCG@10 from 0.414 to 0.447, MRR@10 from 0.586 to 0.595 and MAP@10 from 0.270 to 0.308 across six datasets, while the legal-only model remained best on the most specialized tasks.

items.title: Evaluating Advanced Prompting on Gemini Flash for Multi-Hop Biomedical QA
items.title_zh: 评估高级提示策略在 Gemini Flash 多跳生物医学问答中的表现
items.summary: The authors evaluated Gemini Flash models on the MedHopQA challenge using a multi-component prompt combining role-playing, multi-shot chain-of-thought examples and detailed formatting rules. Their best prompt reached a Concept Level Score of 0.720 versus 0.565 for a baseline prompt, nearly matching the result from Gemini 2.5 Flash.

items.title: BlenderRAG: High-Fidelity 3D Object Generation via Retrieval-Augmented Code Synthesis
items.title_zh: BlenderRAG：基于检索增强代码合成的高保真三维物体生成
items.summary: University of Bologna researchers present BlenderRAG, a retrieval-augmented system that pulls semantically similar expert-validated examples to turn natural-language prompts into Blender code. It lifted compilation success from 40.8% to 70.0% across four LLMs without fine-tuning.

items.title: AcademiClaw: When Students Set Challenges for AI Agents
items.title_zh: AcademiClaw：当学生给 AI 智能体出难题
items.summary: AcademiClaw is a bilingual benchmark of 80 long-horizon academic tasks sourced from university students and run in Docker sandboxes across more than 25 domains; the best of six frontier models passes only 55%, and 16 tasks require CUDA GPUs.

items.title: SubQ: a sub-quadratic LLM with 12M-token context
items.title_zh: SubQ：上下文达 1200 万 Token 的亚二次方 LLM
items.summary: Subquadratic introduces SubQ, described as a sub-quadratic LLM with a 12-million-token context window, from a company building a new class of models. The announcement drew 84 points and 40 comments on Hacker News.
